# BidayaLab

> What is BidayaLab? BidayaLab is a digital transformation agency and software development firm based in Marrakech, Morocco. The agency specializes in building custom enterprise software, automating SME operations with artificial intelligence, and designing premium visual identities.

## Main URL
https://www.bidayalab.com

## Key Pages
- About: https://www.bidayalab.com/about
- Work: https://www.bidayalab.com/works
- Blog: https://www.bidayalab.com/blogs
- Contact: https://www.bidayalab.com/contact
- Privacy Policy: https://www.bidayalab.com/privacy

## Core Expertise
- AI Automation: Autonomous AI agents, 24/7 customer service chatbots, and custom workflow automation.
- Web Engineering: Scaleable SaaS applications, high-performance corporate websites, and e-commerce infrastructure (Next.js, React).
- Visual Storytelling: Premium brand identity design, motion graphics, and corporate videography.

## Headquarters & Location
Marrakech, Morocco. Operating globally (Supported timezones: GMT to EST).
